title: iOS 17 crash on startup
body:
### Tested versions

v4.5.beta.mono.double.custom_build [39e6a67fc]

### System information

Godot v4.5.beta.mono.double (39e6a67fc) - Pop!_OS 22.04 LTS on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 3 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 SUPER (nvidia; 565.77) - AMD Ryzen 7 5800X 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 31.26 GiB memory

### Issue description

Exported ios projects crash immediately on startup with iOS 17.  iOS 18 works fine.  Here is the crash report:
